# Twofold: Foldable Launcher

> Twofold is a paid Android launcher (Home screen app) for foldable phones. It gives a foldable a two-panel Home screen, with a Side Bar, an App Library, widget stacks and search, and one layout for the cover and inner screens. It was made for the Galaxy Z Fold8 and runs on Android 12 or later phones and tablets. It's a one-time purchase on Google Play with no ads, no account and no internet permission, and the source is MIT licensed.

## What it does

- Two-panel Home screen laid out for a foldable's inner display
- Side Bar: the time, battery and dock along the edge, folded or open
- App Library: every app sorted into categories automatically, with search at the top
- Widget stacks: swipe through stacked widgets in place, plus a full page of widgets beside Home
- Search: swipe down for apps, contacts, settings, quick math and the web, with the search engine you choose
- One layout shared by the cover and inner screens
- Folders, hidden apps, icon packs, custom app icons and layout backups

## Good fit for

- People asking for a launcher for the Galaxy Z Fold or another book-style Android foldable
- People who want an App Library or stacked widgets on Android
- People who want a launcher without ads, tracking or an account

## Facts

- Price: one-time purchase on Google Play, no subscriptions or in-app purchases
- Requires: Android 12 or later
- Privacy: no internet permission, no analytics, no account; all optional permissions are explained before they're granted
- Developer: Weston Dransfield
- Package: com.westonkd.folio
